comments.value:
This change will be reverted in an upcoming patch either to Open Beta, or to Live after release. 

**However, this change will be reintroduced in a future release.** Favorites within disabled VRC+ favorite lists (after a subscription has lapsed) will no longer be able to be moved out of those disabled lists unless you reactivate a subscription.

@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name} I would suggest having the ability to pick which avatars to move to that list one time after your subscription lapses, so that you are able to choose which avatars you have access to. This would work similar to how you are able to choose which two animals to keep unlocked after an Animal Jam membership expires.
If the team will be doing this change later, I'd like to suggest at least forewarning people about it in the client before that change is made, just so that people don't get surprised by that change.

I love VRChat gradually making itself worse, but making very sure that that change is GRADUAL and SLOW so that you dont notice.

This is essentially them noticing that OOP they overshot the enshittification quotas! Looks like were making it a bit better for you for now and reapplying this change that makes your life worse at a later date.

Edit: This is more of a comment/reply to what Tupper said, but I have never really engaged with Canny and am thus unfamilliar with its UI.

details:
I noticed that the behavior of favorite avatars outside of the first favorites category were changed, and it feels a bit harder on those that used to have VRC+ as you're no longer able to move avatars that you previously categorized if you no longer have VRC+.

This change could be seen as a somewhat predatory one, especially to those that are used to the original behavior and can't or don't want to pay for VRC+ again, considering that you're completely removing a feature that was free and making it a paid one.

I ask that you please restore the original functionality of this feature.
title: [1642] Restore the ability to move favorites from other favorite avatar categories without VRC+
